card.name: Small words in alcohol interaction sentences
card.fires_on: Small linking words (the, and, to) or a partial word like 'hyp' in psychiatric drug interaction text, usually right after 'alcohol' or 'potentiate' and before the effects described.

modes.label: After potentiate/influence
modes.description: The word 'the' after a verb like potentiate or influence, in statements about a drug and alcohol effects.

modes.label: After alcohol or sedation
modes.description: The word 'and' joining alcohol or sedation to a further effect or drug.

modes.label: Other drug-label links
modes.description: Partial word or linking word elsewhere in psychiatric drug label text.
modes.example: The use of alcohol with this drug should be avoided due to possible additive effects and<< hyp>>otension.
